text:
Ethan (AE): Customer asked for our CAIQ dump + a one-page shared-responsibility blurb for encryption/KMS before POC kickoff. Also want a two-week POC price for Dedicated vs hosted-with-CMK. Can someone grab this?

Nia (Sec): I can own CAIQ answers. Need confirmation on regions (EU/US?), whether they require customer-managed keys (CMK) and if logs must be sent to their SIEM.

Priya (SE): From convo: EU + US, will use CMK, low traffic (~5 rps), testing 8k token generation. They prefer Dedicated for isolation but open to hosted-with-CMK if cost is much lower.

Marco (Infra): Operational notes: Dedicated POC with CMK -> requires VPC peering (or Private deployment) and customer KMS grant. Hosted-with-CMK -> we can integrate with customer's KMS but need IAM role + audit events forwarded. Network/setup adds ~2 business days.

pricing-bot: CAIQ template: https://redwood.internal/security/ca iq/ca iq-2025-export (internal)

Nia (Sec): Draft shared-resp (plain):
- Redwood: manages model serving, instance patching, kernel-level code, encryption-at-rest for platform objects, and runtime logs collection.
- Customer: responsible for data they send to the API, client-side key material if CMK chosen, and app-level secrets (API keys).
- When CMK is enabled: Redwood never stores plaintext key material. We request cryptographic grants to perform encryption/decryption; audit logs show key usage. Customer retains ability to revoke grants which will block decryption.

Priya (SE): CAIQ answer for encryption control: "We use TLS 1.2+/modern ciphers in transit; platform storage uses AES-256. For CMK we integrate with AWS KMS/GCP KMS; key usage is logged and customers can provide key policies restricting operations. Logs containing PII can be routed to customer-owned buckets on request."

Marco (Infra): Quick cost sketch for POC (rough estimates):
- Dedicated (1x A10G-equivalent pool, 2 weeks reserved + storage + egress): ~USD 17,500 (includes small buffer for burst).
- Hosted-with-CMK (shared pool + CMK integration): ~USD 2,600 (mostly usage + egress).
Notes: If they require on-prem Private deployment, add deployment/setup fee and infra quoting.

Ethan (AE): Perfect. Nia, please export CAIQ with R/Y/G flags and attach. Priya, add a 1-page runbook: steps for VPC peering, KMS grant, and smoke test commands. Marco, convert cost sketch into line items + optional faster setup fee.

Nia (Sec): Will export CAIQ and mark exceptions. ETA: EOD.

Priya (SE): Runbook draft by 3pm.

Marco (Infra): I'll post a pricing spreadsheet link when ready. ETA 4pm.

Ethan (AE): I'll tell customer 48h turnaround and flag that Dedicated takes longer to stand up than hosted. Thanks all :thumbsup:
